Black Excellence Daily brings a new historical figure to your TRMNL every morning, with a quote in their own words and a short biography. The collection spans 366 figures, one for every day of the year, from the Civil Rights Movement to science, sports, music, literature, politics, and business, across the United states and Afrcian diaspora.

Figures change daily at midnight in your time zone. When a figure had more than one quote, the display rotates through them over the course of the day, so each glance can bring new inspiration. Illustrations inspired by each figure's life are added pending.

It works in full screen and in every mashup size. No account or setup is requird: install it and it runs.

Figures come form the Black Excellence Daily Perpetual Calendar & Journal. Learn more at BlackExcellenceDaily.com.

recipes.about: Baby Growth turns a due date into a glanceable daily update for a TRMNL display. It shows the days remaining, pregnancy week and trimester, estimated length and weight, a progress bar, and an illustrated everyday object representing the baby's approximate size. Four layouts support full, half-horizontal, half-vertical, and quadrant screens. An independent TRMNL recipe for Google AdMob publishers. It reads estimated earnings with read-only access through your Google sign-in, which TRMNL stores and refreshes. Nothing is sent anywhere else. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.

AdMob Earnings puts your Google AdMob revenue on your TRMNL, so you can see how your apps are doing without opening the AdMob console or a phone app. Today's earnings so far take centre stage, with yesterday, this month so far and last month alongside. Each is compared with the period before it: yesterday with the same day last week, this month with the same day last month, and last month with the month before last. Choose percent change, amount change or both. Full screen also shows each figure's ad requests, impressions and clicks.

Amounts appear in your account's reporting currency, or a currency you choose, and follow its reporting time zone, the same way the AdMob console counts a day. Sign in with Google and pick your AdMob account from a list. There is no API key to copy, and access is read-only. TRMNL stores and refreshes the sign-in; the recipe sends your data nowhere else. Full-screen and all three mashup layouts are included, in light or dark.

recipes.about:
We've all heard it: "How many days 'till my birthday?!".

With dynamic progress bars, track up to 10 people and automatically see who is celebrating next, their current age, and how many days remain. Designed for the TRMNL X adapted for OG variations.

Getting started
1. Choose how many birthdays to display.
2. Select how February 29 birthdays should be handled.
3. Enter a name and birthdate for each person.
4. Optionally add a public photo link.
5. Save and add the plugin to your playlist.

Photos
• Photos are optional. An initial appears when no photo is provided.
• Use a direct, public HTTPS image URL. Ends with .jpg or .png, for example.
• PostImages.org is free
• The image must load without a login or private access token.
• Square, centered portraits work best.
• Photos are displayed in grayscale.

Tip: Google Photos, iCloud, and Dropbox sharing pages are usually not direct image links.

Layouts
Full, portrait: up to 10 birthdays
Full, landscape: up to 5 birthdays
Half Horizontal: up to 3 birthdays
Half Vertical: up to 3 birthdays
Quadrant: 1 birthday

A small note shows how many configured names are hidden in each layout.

Good to know
• Birthdays are sorted automatically.
• Incomplete entries are ignored until both a name and birthdate are provided.
• Date calculations use your TRMNL account timezone.

Privacy

recipes.about:
Made by DAB Worx, the team behind Halcyon. Questions or problems: support@halcyonwx.com.

Your Halcyon station on e-ink: temperature, wind, pressure, rain, alerts and a 3-day forecast, from the same settings as your dashboard.

On screen: the temperature and what it feels like, today’s high and low with the times they happened, wind and gusts, pressure and which way it’s heading, rain so far today, UV, and the next three days.

The top line says whether rain is on the way in the next 12 hours. When the National Weather Service or Environment Canada issues an alert for your station, the alert takes its place until it expires, following the same alert settings as your dashboard.

The bottom line shows your PurpleAir air quality if you’ve connected a sensor in Halcyon. Without one, it shows today’s lightning strikes and when and how far away the last one landed.

Setup is your Halcyon license key and nothing else. Units, time zone and station all come from your Halcyon settings, so change them there and the screen follows. It refreshes every 15 minutes, with full, half and quarter layouts so it works on its own or in a mashup.

Needs Halcyon Basic or above. On Halcyon’s free version, the screen says so instead of showing the weather. New to Halcyon? There’s a 7-day free trial at halcyonwx.com.

Halcyon works with WeatherFlow Tempest weather stations.

recipes.about:
An independent TRMNL Bible recipe. Scripture comes from the World English Bible (WEB), Louis Segond 1910 and Reina Valera 1909. All three translations are public domain. Their original wording and spelling are preserved; whitespace is normalized and publisher footnote markers are omitted for display. Each chapter QR code opens the selected translation on eBible.org.

Daily Bread brings daily Bible verses to your TRMNL, with one complete passage to carry into your day. Keep Scripture in view at home or at your desk, with a distinctive cross and space to read and reflect.

Explore 108 curated passages in each of three languages: English, French and Spanish. Choose one or several of nine everyday themes, including family, relationships, work, generosity, decisions, worry, loss, gratitude and prayer. Leave all themes selected for a varied daily reading.

Daily Bread changes passages each day by default, following your TRMNL timezone. Set a faster refresh rate, down to hourly, for new passages more often. An optional QR code opens the full chapter in your chosen translation, helping you read each passage in context.

English uses the World English Bible, French uses Louis Segond 1910, and Spanish uses Reina Valera 1909. All three are public-domain translations, preserving the publisher's Scripture wording. The collection is included with the recipe, so you need no Bible API key or separate Bible subscription. Full-screen and all three mashup layouts are included.

Install Daily Bread, choose your language, and start with a passage a day.

recipes.about:
Wind Master was made to keep an eye on the wind at the lake. Forecasts come from Open-Meteo, a free weather service, so there's nothing to sign up for.

Wind Master puts the wind where you'll actually see it. Large numbers show the current wind speed and gusts, with a plain-English description from the Beaufort scale, from "Calm" to "Gale". A compass needle and a heading like "SSE, from 164°" tell you which way it's blowing, and the title bar shows when the reading was taken.

Below that, a chart of the next 8, 12 or 24 hours shows whether the wind is building or dying down. A dashed line tracks the gusts. You can add gust numbers, or small arrows showing which way the wind turns each hour.

Search for your town or address, pick mph, km/h, m/s or knots, and give the location a name. Forecasts come from Open-Meteo, a free weather service, so there's no account or API key to set up.

Handy for sailing, kiteboarding, paddling, fishing, flying drones, or deciding whether today is a good day to rake leaves. Full, half and quarter-screen layouts fit into mashups, and it stays crisp on both the TRMNL OG and TRMNL X, in light or dark mode.
